title: Great for Tailgating!
text: Great for Tailgating!. It's college football season and these paper goods are great for tailgating! The quality of items is good. I wouldn't call them super high quality, but they're more than adequate. The set comes with 2 different sizes of disposable plates, cups, napkins, table cloth and a banner. One stop shopping!

product_metadata.title: Football Party Supplies Kit Serve 25, Includes Disposable Dinner Plates, Dessert Plates, Napkins, Cups,and Football Tablecloth, Perfect for Football Birthday Party Tailgate Party Decorations
features: SERVE 25: Football theme birthday party supplies pack contains, 25 x 9 inch paper dinner plate, 25 x 7 inch paper dessert plates, 25 x 9 oz cups, 25 x paper napkins (3ply, 6.5” x 6.5”folded), 1 pc 54 x 108 inch disposable plastic touchdown tablecloth, 1 set paperbanner (It combines by yard number of the field and the football pattern).

ECO-FRIENDLY & DURABLE PARTYWARE：Those disposable paper plates, napkins, cups are all printed with food grade water-based inks,suitable for food contact. The plates are made of thick cardboard and film laminated to ensure its durability and hold more food.

SAVE YOUR TIME -- Football party disposable tableware set save you from the hassle of dishes-washing. Enjoy more time with your guests. This party pack contains all of your gaming birthday party tableware needs and is completely disposable.

DECORATE YOUR PARTY! Football Party Games Decoration Paper Plates ， Napkins，Cups，Banner and Touchdown Tablecloth Perfect for Football party and Football birthday party, next game day sports event party, catering and other Football competition with friends.
Great for the whole family and friends gathering for fun!
